resolutions.researcher_notes: P5859's own segment_name is 'Phase I, Gao'an-Fengcheng' (wiki section '高安-丰城输气干线'), but the 2014 Jiangxi DRC provincial gas plan names exactly SIX Phase I trunk lines and 'Gao'an-Fengcheng' is not one of them: 九江-南昌 (Jiujiang-Nanchang), 九江-沙河 (Jiujiang-Shahe), 九江-景德镇 (Jiujiang-Jingdezhen), 南昌-丰城 (Nanchang-Fengcheng), 高安-新余 (Gao'an-Xinyu), 丰城-抚州 (Fengcheng-Fuzhou), plus one branch (田南-上高). Cross-checked this run's sibling payloads per the BRIEF's fan-out rule: GEM already carries separate rows matching FOUR of these six names — 'Phase I, Nanchang-Fengcheng' (batch_02), 'Phase I, Fengcheng-Fuzhou Gas Pipeline' AND 'Phase I, Gao'an-Xinyu' (both batch_01), and 'XinYu Branch(Gao'an-Xinyu)' (batch_11 — note this may itself be a near-duplicate of batch_01's Gao'an-Xinyu row, worth that shard's attention). So P5859's 'Gao'an-Fengcheng' pairing sits between two already-tracked trunks (Gao'an-Xinyu and Nanchang-Fengcheng/Fengcheng-Fuzhou) without appearing in this 2014 summary of the six official Phase I trunks. This is NOT a recommendation to delete or fold the row — the 2014 document is a headline summary, not necessarily an exhaustive segment inventory, and the network has grown since (petrobest.com's Phase I total is 876km vs the 2014 plan's 870km, so at least some further Phase I mileage was added after 2014, and a Gao'an-Fengcheng connector is geographically plausible as infill between the two named trunks). Flagging for human review: is 'Gao'an-Fengcheng' a real later-built connector, or a mislabeling/partial-duplicate of the Gao'an-Xinyu + Nanchang-Fengcheng pair already on the sheet? This is also why no segment-specific Location/Start source could be found despite extensive search (11 harvest-pool URLs opened plus 2 targeted Chinese searches) — every source found describes the adjacent, already-tracked trunks instead. Separately checked P5859 against the reciprocal-duplicate pattern flagged elsewhere in this run (P4778 'Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network, Phase I, Gao'an-Xinyu' vs P5861 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, XinYu Branch(Gao'an-Xinyu)' — identical corridor/StartYear1-Month1=2010-12/Capacity=1.00bcm/y under two different parent-system attributions): queried the live sheet directly for P5859, P4793 (WEP2, Gao'an-Yujiang) and P4794 (WEP2, Jiujiang-Gao'an) and for any other row touching 'Fengcheng'. P5859 carries no WEP2/WEP3 FuelSource or PipelineName attribution at all (already correctly filed under 'Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network', FuelSource blank), and no WEP-family row exists anywhere in the sheet covering a Gao'an-Fengcheng or equivalent corridor — so that specific misattribution pattern does not extend to this row. The only Fengcheng-adjacent rows are P4776 (Fengcheng-Fuzhou) and P4782 (Nanchang-Fengcheng), neither of which duplicates P5859's Gao'an-Fengcheng endpoints. The naming-discrepancy concern above (no source names a 'Gao'an-Fengcheng' trunk) stands as a separate, narrower question from the WEP2-misattribution pattern, and is NOT resolved by this check.
